desktop/gpui/Cargo.toml.content:
[package]
name = "twyne-desktop"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.92"
description = "Twyne's native, offline writing room, built with GPUI"
publish = false

[features]
default = ["desktop"]
desktop = ["dep:gpui-kit", "dep:image", "dep:roxmltree", "dep:base64", "dep:hypher", "dep:unicode-linebreak", "dep:x11rb", "dep:gpui-linux", "native-typst"]
native-typst = ["dep:typst", "dep:typst-pdf", "dep:typst-svg", "dep:sha2", "dep:image"]
native-audio = ["dep:sha2"]
ui-tests = ["desktop", "gpui-kit/test-support", "gpui-linux?/test-support"]

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0"
directories = "6.0"
fs2 = "0.4"
gpui-kit = { version = "=0.7.0", optional = true }
chrono = "=0.4.45"
html5ever = "=0.27.0"
unicode-segmentation = "=1.13.3"
markup5ever_rcdom = "=0.3.0"
image = { version = "=0.25.10", default-features = false, features = ["png", "webp", "jpeg", "gif"], optional = true }
roxmltree = { version = "=0.20.0", optional = true }
base64 = { version = "=0.22.1", optional = true }
hypher = { version = "=0.1.8", default-features = false, features = ["alloc", "english"], optional = true }
unicode-linebreak = { version = "=0.1.5", optional = true }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive", "rc"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
regex = "=1.13.1"
unicode-normalization = "=0.1.25"
url = "=2.5.8"
tempfile = "3.23"
uuid = { version = "1.18", features = ["v4", "serde"] }
sha2 = { version = "=0.10.9", optional = true }
typst = { git = "https://github.com/Myriad-Dreamin/typst.git", rev = "951788cc614cd805d5d786e17bbf93796df73d10", optional = true }
typst-pdf = { git = "https://github.com/Myriad-Dreamin/typst.git", rev = "951788cc614cd805d5d786e17bbf93796df73d10", optional = true }
typst-svg = { git = "https://github.com/Myriad-Dreamin/typst.git", rev = "951788cc614cd805d5d786e17bbf93796df73d10", optional = true }

[target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")'.dependencies]
x11rb = { version = "=0.13.2", optional = true }
gpui-linux = { package = "gpui-pre-linux", version = "=0.3.7", default-features = false, features = ["wayland"], optional = true }

[[bin]]
name = "twyne-desktop"
path = "src/main.rs"
required-features = ["desktop"]

[[example]]
name = "twyne-clipboard-probe"
path = "fixtures/editor/clipboard-probe.rs"
required-features = ["desktop"]

[[example]]
name = "twyne-wayland-clipboard-probe"
path = "fixtures/wayland-clipboard/native-probe.rs"
required-features = ["desktop"]

[[example]]
name = "twyne-dossier-multiply-probe"
path = "fixtures/dossier-multiply/native-probe/main.rs"
required-features = ["ui-tests"]

[[test]]
name = "native-audio-contract"
path = "fixtures/native-audio/synthetic_loopback.rs"
required-features = ["native-audio"]

[profile.dev]
debug = 0

[patch.crates-io]
gpui-base = { path = "vendor/gpui-base" }
gpui-pre = { path = "vendor/gpui-pre" }
gpui-pre-wgpu = { path = "vendor/gpui-pre-wgpu" }
gpui-pre-linux = { path = "vendor/gpui-pre-linux" }

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
strip = true
